# Prakash Kumar Singh

> Agentic engineer. Founder of YourLio AI. Builds LLM agents, memory layers,
> evals and automation and broadcast workflows that run in production.

Site: https://prkskrs.github.io/

## Who he is

Prakash Kumar Singh is an agentic engineer based in Bengaluru, India. He designs
and ships LLM agent systems: agent orchestration, memory that survives long
horizons, retrieval, tool use, Model Context Protocol servers, evaluation
pipelines, and automation and broadcast workflows across messaging platforms.

## Current work

Founder and CEO of YourLio AI, an agent platform where a single agent carries one
memory layer across every channel a customer appears on. Live with 100+ brands,
$2M+ in attributed revenue across 50K+ orders.

## Background

Founding engineer at AnswersAi, which Quizlet acquired, where he scaled serving to
50K+ questions a day. Engineering at Sprouts.ai (backed by Accel), TexAu, Let's
Hang (100K+ users) and Infosys. B.Tech in Computer Science, KLE Technological
University.

## Writing and teaching

20+ articles on Medium and dev.to read 50K+ times, and developer video with
multiple posts past 200K+ views. Combined audience over 500K+.
